philippians.4.6-6.text: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

philippians.4.7-7.text: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

philippians.4.8-8.text: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report; if there is any virtue, and if there is any praise, think about these things.

proverbs.11.25-25.text: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.

proverbs.15.1-1.text: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

proverbs.16.3-3.text: Commit your deeds to Yahweh, and your plans shall succeed.

proverbs.16.9-9.text: A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.

proverbs.17.22-22.text: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

proverbs.18.10-10.text: Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

proverbs.19.21-21.text: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.

proverbs.22.6-6.text: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.

proverbs.3.5-5.text: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.

proverbs.3.6-6.text: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

proverbs.4.23-23.text: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.

psalms.100.4-4.text: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

psalms.103.12-12.text: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

psalms.118.24-24.text: This is the day that Yahweh has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

psalms.118.6-6.text: Yahweh is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

psalms.119.105-105.text: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

psalms.121.1-1.text: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?

psalms.121.7-7.text: Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.

psalms.139.14-14.text: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.

psalms.145.18-18.text: Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

psalms.147.3-3.text: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

psalms.16.11-11.text: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.

psalms.18.2-2.text: Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

psalms.19.1-1.text: The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

psalms.23.1-1.text: Yahweh is my shepherd: I shall lack nothing.

psalms.23.4-4.text: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

psalms.27.1-1.text: Yahweh is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? Yahweh is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?

psalms.27.14-14.text: Wait for Yahweh. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for Yahweh.

psalms.28.7-7.text: Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

psalms.30.5-5.text: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

psalms.32.8-8.text: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

psalms.34.18-18.text: Yahweh is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

psalms.34.4-4.text: I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

psalms.37.4-4.text: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

psalms.37.5-5.text: Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

psalms.42.11-11.text: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

psalms.46.1-1.text: God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

psalms.46.10-10.text: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted in the earth.”

psalms.51.10-10.text: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

psalms.55.22-22.text: Cast your burden on Yahweh, and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

psalms.56.3-3.text: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

psalms.62.1-1.text: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.

psalms.73.26-26.text: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

psalms.9.9-9.text: Yahweh will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.

psalms.90.12-12.text: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

psalms.91.1-1.text: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

revelation.1.8-8.text: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”

revelation.21.4-4.text: He will wipe away every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more. The first things have passed away.”

revelation.21.5-5.text: He who sits on the throne said, “Behold, I am making all things new.” He said, “Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.”

revelation.3.20-20.text: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him, and will dine with him, and he with me.

revelation.7.9-9.text: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude, which no man could count, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.

romans.10.13-13.text: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”

romans.10.9-9.text: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord, and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

romans.12.1-1.text: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

romans.12.2-2.text: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

romans.12.3-3.text: For I say, through the grace that was given me, to every man who is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.

romans.14.8-8.text: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

romans.15.1-1.text: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

romans.15.13-13.text: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.

romans.2.1-1.text: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.

romans.3.23-23.text: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;

romans.5.1-1.text: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

romans.5.8-8.text: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

romans.6.23-23.text: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

romans.8.28-28.text: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, to those who are called according to his purpose.

romans.8.31-31.text: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

romans.8.37-37.text: No, in all these things, we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

zechariah.4.10-10.text: Indeed, who despises the day of small things? For these seven shall rejoice, and shall see the plumb line in the hand of Zerubbabel. These are Yahweh’s eyes, which run back and forth through the whole earth.”

zephaniah.3.17-17.text: Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save. He will rejoice over you with joy. He will calm you in his love. He will rejoice over you with singing.
